SAP BRIM Technical Consultant

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

Your Role:

SAP BRIM CI Configuration: Designing and configuring the CI module to meet specific business requirements, including pricing, taxation, and integration with other SAP modules (e.g., FI-CA, CC).
• ABAP on S/4 Hana: Proficient in developing code in S/4 Hana.
• Performance Tuning: Assist in system performance tuning to ensure optimal operation of the SAP

• Project Management: Assisting in project planning, timelines, resource allocation, and tracking deliverables.
• Documentation and Training: Creating clear documentation and providing user training for effective system adoption.
• Staying Current: Keeping up-to-date with SAP BRIM updates and best practices.
• Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
• Functional Testing: Performing functional testing and validation of configurations.
• Data Migration: Assisting with data migration activities related to CI.

Your Profile:

  • 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in SAP ABAP and ABAP on HANA and SAP BRIM CI Technical
  • Billing and Invoice Management: Proficient in designing and testing invoice document flows, ensuring accurate and efficient billing.
    • Troubleshooting and Optimization: Identifying and resolving issues in end-to-end billing processes, optimizing CI performance.
    • Integration with other SAP Modules: Ensuring seamless integration with other SAP modules like FI-CA, SOM, and SD.
  • SAP BRIM Experience: Proven experience in SAP BRIM, including CI, FI-CA, and ideally CC.
    • Configuration Expertise: Hands-on experience with SAP BRIM CI configuration.
    • End-to-End Process Knowledge: Understanding of the entire billing and invoicing process flow within SAP BRIM.Knowledge of SAP FI-CA: Understanding of the FI-CA module and its integration with CI.
    • Knowledge of Convergent Charging: Familiarity with Convergent Charging and its integration with CI is preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with various stakeholders.
    • Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze and resolve complex issues related to billing and invoicing.
    • Project Management: Experience in project planning and execution.
    • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
    • Documentation Skills: Ability to create clear and concise documentation.

What will you love working at Capgemini – PVP:

  • Opportunities to work with global clients on innovative SAP projects.
  • Dynamic and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Continuous learning and professional development support.
